The BQi Utility 200 is built as a practical alternative to a car for city life. With pedal-assist riding and modular cargo options, it’s designed to handle family transport, daily errands, and urban commuting in one balanced, utility-first ride.

With a top speed of 25 km/h, peak power of 530 W, and a removable 693.7 Wh battery, the BQi Utility 200 delivers a reliable range of up to 95 km. Its performance system is tuned for efficiency, comfort, and consistent output on mixed urban routes.

The integrated hybrid drive combines pedal assist and throttle for low-effort mobility. Riders can choose between three assist modes, use walk assist at 6 km/h, or rely on a 7-speed derailleur and strong climbing capability for varied terrain.

Designed beyond standard e-bike limits, the BQi Utility 200 features a front basket, rear rack, and central cargo platform. Expandable utility accessories allow it to adapt easily to groceries, bags, or larger transport needs.

Urban safety is supported by front and rear hydraulic disc brakes and a full LED lighting system with a halo headlamp. A 3.5” color LCD dashboard and USB charging port add smart, everyday convenience for connected riding.
